'''Naval Station Validusia''' was located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Bes Ber Bikade sector/Legends|Bes Ber Bikade sector]]. It was used to [[Refueling station|refuel]] [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]], and at least fifteen [[Starship/Legends|starships]], including an [[Assertor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Assertor''-class Star Dreadnought]], could dock at the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] at the same [[Time/Legends|time]].

==Description==
Naval Station Validusia was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-colored celestial body<ref name="EGTW" /> in a [[Validusia system/Legends|star system]] that was situated in the [[Bes Ber Bikade sector/Legends|Bes Ber Bikade sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> as part of the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="WesternReaches" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The station was thirty-one [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] long and twenty-one kilometers wide and was seventeen kilometers in height.<ref name="Endnotes" /> It featured a central body with two tower-like structures of similar height, one at its top and one at the bottom. Naval Station Validusia was equipped with [[Starship/Legends|starship]] docking installations, including extended docking arms, at both its central body and bottom tower. Multiple large spheres of different sizes were also attached to the station's exterior.<ref name="EGTW" />

Naval Station Validusia could [[Refueling station|refuel]] [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnoughts]] and [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruisers]]. At minimum, its facilities could accommodate the simultaneous docking of one [[Assertor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Assertor''-class Star Dreadnought]], two [[Bellator-class dreadnought/Legends|''Bellator''-class dreadnought]], two [[Allegiance-class battlecruiser|''Allegiance''-class battlecruisers]], two [[Secutor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Secutor''-class Star Destroyers]], and eight [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==History==
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Naval Station Validusia was used to [[Fuel/Legends|refuel]] [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. At one point, Imperial dreadnoughts and battlecruisers awaited refueling at the station, with two ''Assertor''-class [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnoughts]], two ''Bellator''-class dreadnoughts, and two ''Allegiance''-class battlecruisers being present at or near the facility. At the [[Time/Legends|time]], [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] of the ''Secutor''- and ''Imperial''-classes were also docked at the station, and [[Altor-class replenishment ship|''Altor''-class replenishment ships]], [[Vigil-class corvette|''Vigil''-class corvettes]], [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]], [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wings]], and [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]] were all also present in its vicinity.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Here's one of the awesome vistas brought to life by Ansel Hsiao, a talented artist whose original ship designs had excited fans for years before Erich ''[Schoeneweiss]'' brought him aboard for Warfare.|Jason Fry, on the illustration of Naval Station Validusia in ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''|<ref name="Endnotes" />}}
[[File:Imperial_Drydock_IV.png|thumb|right|280px|The appearance of Naval Station Validusia was inspired by that of Imperial Drydock IV (pictured).]]
Naval Station Validusia was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]. In the book, it was illustrated by [[Ansel Hsiao]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The latter's rendering of the station's docking arms was inspired by the appearance of<ref name="BBS">{{WebCite|url=https://bbs.stardestroyer.net/viewtopic.php?p=3662245#p3662245|text=Something big|author=[[Ansel Hsiao|fractalsponge1]]|date=2012-04-06|work=[https://bbs.stardestroyer.net StarDestroyer.Net BBS]|archivedate=20240215030608}}</ref> [[Imperial Drydock IV]], a [[Drydock/Legends|facility]] that appeared in<ref name="ImperialPursuit">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: Imperial Pursuit]]''</ref> the [[June]] [[1993]]<ref name="Insider20">{{LucasFanClubCite|20|Lucasfilm's Latest|The Latest From LucasArts Entertainment Co.}}</ref> [[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: Imperial Pursuit|''Tour of Duty: Imperial Pursuit'']] expansion to [[Totally Games]]' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]<ref name="ImperialPursuit" /> of [[February]] 1993.<ref name="YBY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] containing Naval Station Validusia in grid square L-15.<ref name="EAOC" />

In the endnotes for ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'', Fry gave the dimensions for the station that were [[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity<ref name="Endnotes" /> and which Hsiao had provided earlier.<ref name="BBS" /> In the endnotes, the name of the station was formatted as "Naval Station ''Validusia''."<ref name="Endnotes" /> This article assumes that the non-italicized form of the name used in the book itself takes precedence.<ref name="EGTW" />
